responsibility: This definition file lists the extra AArch64 microarchitectural tuning flags that supplement the main CPU selection. Each AARCH64_EXTRA_TUNING_OPTION entry names a backend tuning bit such as register-renaming preferences, load/store-pair restrictions, SVE constant CSE, or vector cost-model controls, letting surrounding code generate enums, masks, and override parsing for per-core tuning behavior from a central table.
